text_en: The oracle concerning Tyre. Wail, O ships of Tarshish, for your fortress is destroyed. When they came in from Cyprus they learned of it.
text_cn: 有关提洛的神谕：你们哀号吧！塔尔史士的船只！因为你们的堡垒已遭破坏。由基廷地归来的，他们得到了这消息。

text_en: Be still, O inhabitants of the coast, O merchants of Sidon, your messengers crossed over the sea
text_cn: 海滨的居民，静默吧！漆冬的商贾曾充实了你。

text_en: and were on the mighty waters; your revenue was the grain of Shihor, the harvest of the Nile; you were the merchant of the nations.
text_cn: 在大水之上运来的，是史曷尔的谷物；尼罗河的收获，是她的财富；她成了万民的商场。

text_en: Be ashamed, O Sidon, for the sea has spoken, the fortress of the sea, saying: “I have neither labored nor given birth, I have neither reared young men nor brought up young women. ”
text_cn: 漆冬！羞惭吧！因为海说过：【即海中的堡垒说过：】“我没有分娩过，也没有生产过；没有抚养过青年，也没有养育过处女。”

text_en: When the report comes to Egypt, they will be in anguish over the report about Tyre.
text_cn: 这风声一传到了埃及，大家都为了提洛的消息而战栗。

text_en: Cross over to Tarshish— wail, O inhabitants of the coast!
text_cn: 你们过海到塔尔史士去吧！海滨的居民，你们哀号吧！

text_en: Is this your exultant city whose origin is from days of old, whose feet carried her to settle far away?
text_cn: 这就是你们所夸耀的城吗？她本起源于上古，她的双脚曾将她带至远方寄居。

text_en: Who has planned this against Tyre, the bestower of crowns, whose merchants were princes, whose traders were the honored of the earth?
text_cn: 是谁策划了这事，来反对加过冕的提洛？她的商贾本来都是王侯，商贩本来都是地上的显要。

text_en: The Lord of hosts has planned it— to defile the pride of all glory, to shame all the honored of the earth.
text_cn: 是万军的上主策划了这事，为打击她一切自矜的狂傲，侮辱地上所有的显要。

text_en: Cross over to your own land, O ships of Tarshish; this is a harbor no more.
text_cn: 塔尔史士女儿！耕种你的地吧！海港也不在了！

text_en: He has stretched out his hand over the sea, he has shaken the kingdoms; the Lord has given command concerning Canaan to destroy its fortresses.
text_cn: 上主的手已伸在海上，使万国战栗震惊；上主对客纳罕已决定，要摧毁她的要塞。

text_en: He said: You will exult no longer, O oppressed virgin daughter Sidon; rise, cross over to Cyprus— even there you will have no rest.
text_cn: 他说过：“漆冬女儿！遭虐待的处女，你不要再欢乐！起来，往基廷去！在那里你也得不到安宁！”

text_en: Look at the land of the Chaldeans! This is the people; it was not Assyria. They destined Tyre for wild animals. They erected their siege towers, they tore down her palaces, they made her a ruin.
text_cn: 看基廷的地域！【她已不成为民族，亚述已将她委弃予野兽；】人设立了高塔，毁坏了她的宫殿，使她成了一片废墟。

text_en: Wail, O ships of Tarshish, for your fortress is destroyed.
text_cn: 塔尔史士的船只！你们哀号吧！因为你们的堡垒已遭破坏！

text_en: From that day Tyre will be forgotten for seventy years, the lifetime of one king. At the end of seventy years, it will happen to Tyre as in the song about the prostitute:
text_cn: 到那天，提洛将被遗忘七十年之久，有如一位君王的岁月。过了七十年，提洛要像妓女歌曲中所唱的：

text_en: Take a harp, go about the city, you forgotten prostitute! Make sweet melody, sing many songs, that you may be remembered.
text_cn: “被遗忘的妓女！拿琴游城吧？巧弹多唱吧！好使人再记起你来！”

text_en: At the end of seventy years, the Lord will visit Tyre, and she will return to her trade, and will prostitute herself with all the kingdoms of the world on the face of the earth.
text_cn: 过了七十年，上主要眷顾提洛，她要再接受缠头，与地面世上各国交易。

text_en: Her merchandise and her wages will be dedicated to the Lord ; her profits will not be stored or hoarded, but her merchandise will supply abundant food and fine clothing for those who live in the presence of the Lord .
text_cn: 她的赢利和她的进项将祝圣与上主，必不再贮藏积蓄起来，因为她的赢利将归于那些在上主面前度日的人，使他们吃得饱，穿得体面。
